data.one_liner: A customizable segmented tab control widget with smooth animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a segment tab control widget that can be paired with a TabController or DefaultTabController. It features custom styling for tabs, indicators, and backgrounds, along with smooth selection animations.
use_when: You need a segmented control UI component integrated with a TabController.
You want custom animations and decorations for selected and unselected tabs.
avoid_when: Your application relies on standard package:flutter/material.dart controllers without using material_ui in version 2.2.0+.
You require interactive children elements inside individual tab labels.
strengths: Highly customizable decorations for bars and indicators.
Supports custom label builders and right-to-left layouts.
weaknesses: Requires material_ui package instead of standard material.dart starting from version 2.2.0.
Interactive children inside tab labels are not supported.
data.setup_notes: Requires using TabController or DefaultTabController from package:material_ui/material_ui.dart in version 2.2.0+.
